description: This file defines the 'registry' class responsible for registering functions, complex types, and related symbols for a SOAP-based web service in the SuiteCRM project. It includes method implementations for registering multiple functions and data types used in the service.

classes.name: registry
classes.description: Class responsible for registering service functions and complex types for the SuiteCRM SOAP API.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the registry class with a service class object.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Calls internal methods to register all service functions and data types.

methods.name: registerFunction
methods.description: Registers all the service functions with their input and output schemas.

methods.name: registerTypes
methods.description: Registers complex data types used by the service, such as structs and arrays.
